title: Amtrak PIDS closeout hold: two completion counts and no accepted asset register remain
summary: Both June reports still describe PIDS closeout as pending while publishing incompatible completion counts and no accepted station-asset register. Denominator: The unresolved 93-deployment and 117-installation inventories plus the pending FRA or financial closeout state.
key_findings: Finding: Both June reports still describe PIDS closeout as pending while publishing incompatible completion counts and no accepted station-asset register.
